name: SunPad
notes: Empty app plus a game module made from the player's own disc (D11: no Nintendo keys in the published app).

steps: Open {file} and move SunPad.app to your Applications folder.
Open SunPad. macOS asks whether SunPad may open files in your Documents folder: allow it if your disc image is there. SunPad already contains the game translated from your disc.
Updating? Replace the old SunPad.app with the new one. Your saves are kept.
